grades_v0.reason: No evidence cited (empty evidence_ids). No QBiC-SELEX, ChIP or motif result for FOXA1; FOXA1 choice rests on expression assumed from memory, and qbic_coverage is not_checked.
E03 shows no cCRE overlap, nearest dELS 1868 bp away; this only shows absence of an element. E01 says no regulatory features. Claim of a weak element co-opted by a pioneer factor is speculative.

E02 gives only distance (PELI2 230.8 kb). Proximity at that distance is not evidence of looping; no eQTL, HiC or CRISPR link. The 'only plausible target' claim is unsupported, and E01 says intron_variant while also listing no transcript consequences (inconsistent).
No evidence cited; FOXA1 expression in MCF7 was not looked up (no tf_expression result) and no MCF7 chromatin data at this site.
E06/E06a show PELI2 as a prognostic gene in papillary thyroid carcinoma, not breast cancer; E04 shows no GWAS association and E05 has no breast signal. Does not support breast cancer risk.
No evidence cited; no GATA3 ChIP, motif or QBiC-SELEX data. GATA3 choice is based on assumed luminal expression only.
E01 and E03 show no regulatory annotation and no cCRE; only compatible with a weak element, no positive evidence. GERP -3.12 argues against constraint.

E02 shows KTN1 at 328 kb, but it is not the second-nearest TSS in the list shown (PELI2 first, KTN1 second is correct by distance) and proximity alone is not evidence; the TAD claim is not backed by any cited data.
No evidence cited for GATA3 expression or activity in MCF7.
E04 shows zero GWAS associations, which contradicts rather than supports a breast cancer effect; nothing links KTN1 to breast cancer here.
No evidence cited; no CTCF ChIP peak or motif result at the site. Direction (alt stronger) is unsupported.
E01 and E03 show no cCRE, and no CTCF-bound cCRE (CTCF-only) is overlapping; the insulator claim is speculative.
E02 and E03 give distances only; no contact or boundary data. The effect on PELI2 versus KTN1 is arbitrary.
No evidence cited, but the claim of cell-type invariance is a general property of CTCF and is consistent with MCF7; not shown for this site.
E05 is a brain nucleus accumbens eQTL (PIP 0.03) for ENSG00000259868, not PELI2 or breast; E06a concerns thyroid carcinoma. Neither supports a breast cancer effect via PELI2.

E03 shows no cCRE overlap (nearest is 1868 bp away), E01 shows no regulatory features and GERP is -3.12. This does not show an element; it argues against one.
KTN1 is assigned by distance alone (E02, 328 kb, not the nearest gene), and E09 shows no breast eQTL. Nothing links the variant to KTN1.
No evidence cited. GATA3 expression and occupancy in MCF7 were not looked up, and no MCF7 data bear on this site.
E04 shows 0 GWAS associations, so there is no phenotype support, and a KTN1 effect on breast cancer is not evidenced.

The only cited evidence, E07, shows no FOXA1 peak in MCF-7 at or near the site, which argues against the claim. There is no QBiC-SELEX or motif support, and FOXA1 was picked from the forkhead group by prominence only. Coverage 'not_checked' is not shown by any lookup; suggest qbic_tf_detail for FOXA1.
E03 shows no cCRE overlap and E01 shows no regulatory feature. A pioneer-opened element is speculation with nothing cited for it.
PELI2 is the nearest gene by distance (230.8 kb, E02), but E09 shows no breast eQTL. Proximity at that range is not evidence of regulation.
E07 shows no FOXA1 occupancy at the site in MCF-7, so the cited evidence does not support MCF7 action. It is also only an absence, since a FOXA1 experiment may not exist.
E06a concerns PELI2 as a prognostic gene in papillary thyroid carcinoma, not breast cancer, and E04 shows no GWAS association. Nothing supports a breast cancer effect.

No evidence cited for ESR1 at this site: no motif, ChIP or QBiC-SELEX. The half-ERE is asserted without support. Coverage 'not_checked' is not shown by any lookup; suggest qbic_tf_detail for ESR1 and an ESR1 ChIP check in MCF7.
E03 shows no cCRE overlap and E01 shows no regulatory features. Nothing cited shows an element at the site.

E05 is a molecular QTL credible set for ENSG00000259868 with PIP 0.03 in brain nucleus accumbens. It is genetic context for a gene but is low-PIP and in an irrelevant tissue, so it is a weak link only. It is not the ESR1/MCF7 context and E09 shows no breast eQTL.
The only cited QTL (E05) is in brain, which contradicts the claimed ER+ breast specificity. No MCF7 or ESR1 data are cited.
E04 shows no GWAS association and E09 shows no breast eQTL. The cited evidence contains nothing linking this lncRNA to breast cancer.

E08 shows no CTCF peak containing or within 100 bp of the site in MCF-7, so it contradicts the claim rather than supporting it. No QBiC-SELEX or motif data are cited. Coverage 'not_checked' is not shown by any lookup; suggest qbic_tf_detail for CTCF.
E03 shows no cCRE, including no CTCF-only cCRE, overlapping the site, and E01 reports low conservation. Nothing supports an anchor element.
PELI2 is chosen by distance alone (E02, 230.8 kb). E09 shows no breast eQTL and no contact data are cited.
E08 shows no CTCF peak in MCF-7. The inference that the site is not an anchor anywhere overreaches from one biosample, and the claim of invariance is not backed by cited data.
E04 shows no GWAS association and E05 is a low-PIP brain QTL for a different gene. Nothing supports a breast cancer effect.

next_experiment: Run the QBiC-SELEX lookup for the 12-mer centred on chr14:55887040 (C vs T) across all TF groups. It is existing data, costs nothing, and directly separates the null (no significant binding change in any breast-expressed group) from H3 (GATA-group loss on alt T), while simultaneously grading H2, H4 and H5. If no group shows a significant change, probability mass moves further to H1.
